entries.t: 📌 Definition of Accounting（会计的定义）
entries.b: Definition of Accounting（会计的定义） Accounting is the process of identifying, measuring, recording and communicating economic information to permit informed judgements and economic decisions by users of the information. 会计是识别、计量、记录并传递经济信息的过程，目的是帮助信息使用者做出有依据的判断和经济决策。

entries.t: 📌 Service vs Merchandising Business（服务型与商贸型企业）
entries.b: Service vs Merchandising Business（服务型与商贸型企业） A service business provides intangible services rather than physical goods, whereas a merchandising business buys and resells tangible goods to earn a profit. 服务型企业提供无形服务（如咨询、理发），而商贸型企业通过买入并转售有形商品（存货）来赚取利润。

entries.t: 📌 Book-keeping vs Accounting（簿记与会计的区别）
entries.b: Book-keeping vs Accounting（簿记与会计的区别） Book-keeping is the systematic recording of routine daily transactions, while accounting goes further to prepare financial statements, analyse performance and assist decision-making. 簿记主要负责日常交易的常规记录与录入，而会计在此基础上进一步编制财务报表、分析经营绩效并支持管理与投资决策。

entries.t: 📌 Accounting Entity & Monetary Unit Conventions（会计主体与货币计量惯例）
entries.b: Accounting Entity & Monetary Unit Conventions（会计主体与货币计量惯例） Under the Accounting Entity Convention, the owner’s personal financial dealings are kept separate from the business; under the Monetary Unit Convention, all financial information is recorded in the currency of the operating country. 会计主体惯例要求将老板个人财务与企业财务严格分开，所有交易都站在企业立场记录；货币计量惯例假设所有财务信息都用所在国货币（如澳元）统一计量。

entries.t: 📌 Historical Cost, Going Concern & Accounting Period（历史成本、持续经营与会计分期）
entries.q: Historical Cost, Going Concern & Accounting Period
entries.b: Historical Cost, Going Concern & Accounting Period（历史成本、持续经营与会计分期） Historical Cost records assets at their original purchase price; Going Concern assumes the business will continue indefinitely; Accounting Period divides that indefinite life into regular reporting intervals, usually 12 months. 历史成本按资产取得时的实际买价入账；持续经营假设企业会无限期经营下去；会计分期则把无限生命切分为固定周期（通常 12 个月）以定期编报。

entries.t: 📌 The Accounting Cycle（会计循环六阶段）
entries.b: The Accounting Cycle（会计循环六阶段） The accounting cycle follows six regular stages: business transactions, source documents, journals, ledgers, trial balance, and financial statements (reports). 会计循环按固定顺序包含六个阶段：商业交易 → 原始凭证 → 日记账 → 分类账 → 试算平衡表 → 财务报表，并在下一个会计期间重新开始。

entries.t: 📊 会计是什么、谁用会计信息（What is Accounting）
entries.q: 会计是什么、谁用会计信息（What is Acc
entries.b: 会计是什么、谁用会计信息（What is Accounting） unit1 lecture slides introduction to accounting.pdf · PDF p3–12；unit1 reading materials introduction to accounting.pdf · PDF p1–3；unit1 tutorial guide introduction to accounting.pdf · PDF p2–4, p8–9 概念 会计 （accounting）是识别、计量、记录并传达经济信息的过程，让信息使用者据此做判断和经济决策，被称为「商业的语言」（the language of business）。 服务业 （service business）提供无形服务，收入是服务费，没有存货； 商品流通业 （merchandising business）买进卖出有形商品，收入是销售额，有存货和销货成本。 记账 （book-keeping）是逐日记录交易的例行工作； 会计 范围更广：汇总、分析、报告、解释财务数据，做调整分录和财务分析，遵守会计准则。 信息使用者 ：所有者/股东/管理者、投资者、贷款人/银行、税务机关、竞争对手（讲义 p11），阅读材料还列了审计师。 会计报告的 5 项要求 ：清晰（clarity）、准确（accuracy/reliability）、一致（consistency/comparability）、及时（timely）、合规（

entries.b: 会计循环（The Accounting Cycle） unit1 lecture slides introduction to accounting.pdf · PDF p13–17；unit1 reading materials introduction to accounting.pdf · PDF p4–6；unit1 tutorial guide introduction to accounting.pdf · PDF p5–7 概念 会计循环 是每个会计期间重复的一组标准阶段：①交易（transactions）→ ②原始凭证（source documents）→ ③日记账（journals）→ ④分类账（ledgers）→ ⑤试算平衡表（trial balance）→ ⑥报表（reports），然后下一个会计期间重新开始。 交易只有两种结算方式：现金（cash）和赊账（credit）。原始凭证举例：发票（invoice）、贷项通知单（credit note）、收据（receipt）。 三张报表：利润表（Profit and Loss Statement，又叫 Income Statement / Statement of Financial Performance）反映一个期间的收入和费用；资产负债表（Balance Sheet / Statement of Financial Position）反映某一时点的资产、负债和所有者权益；现金流量表（Cash Flow St

entries.b: 会计惯例（Accounting Conventions） unit2 lecture slides accounting conventions.pdf · PDF p3–17；unit2 reading materials accounting conventions.pdf · PDF p1–4；unit2 tutorial guide accounting conventions.pdf · PDF p2–7 概念 会计惯例 是会计行业长期形成、所有会计人员默认遵守的做法： 货币计量 （monetary）：一切用经营所在国的货币表示（澳大利亚用澳元）。局限：通胀使不同年份难比较；管理水平等无法用货币计量。 历史成本 （historical cost）：资产按原始购买价、实际支付金额入账。 会计主体 （accounting entity）：企业与所有者个人的财务分开，一切从企业的角度记录。 持续经营 （going concern / continuity）：假设企业会无限期经营下去。 会计期间 （accounting period）：把企业的寿命分成相等的期间，通常 12 个月（如 2020 年 7 月 1 日至 2021 年 6 月 30 日）。 复式记账 （double entry / dual aspect）：每笔交易至少影响两个账户，保持会计等式平衡。 权责发生 （accrual）：收入在赚到时确认，费用在发生时确认，与收付现金的时间无关。 一致性 （consiste

entries.q: 会计等式与现金制、权责发生制（Accountin
entries.b: 会计等式与现金制、权责发生制（Accounting Equation; Cash vs Accrual） unit2 reading materials accounting conventions.pdf · PDF p3–5；unit2 lecture slides accounting conventions.pdf · PDF p11–15；unit2 tutorial guide accounting conventions.pdf · PDF p3, p8 概念 会计等式 ：资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益，A = L + OE，也可写成 A − L = OE（净资产）。每笔交易至少影响两项，等式始终成立。提款（drawings）减少所有者权益。 现金制 （cash accounting）：收到现金才记收入，付出现金才记费用，小企业多用。 权责发生制 （accrual accounting）：交易发生时就记录——赊销在卖出时就是收入（同时产生应收账款），赊购在买入时就记采购（同时产生应付账款）；把同一期间的收入和费用配比，得到更有意义的利润，大中型企业多用。 Assets = Liabilities + Owner's Equity A − L = OE 例 22（Reading U2 Ex 1-4） Lighting Warehouse: Ex 1 John introduces cash $30,000 as capital. entries.t: 📌 Assets — Current vs Non-Current（资产：流动与非流动）
entries.b: Assets — Current vs Non-Current（资产：流动与非流动） Assets are items of value owned by or owed to a business that provide future economic benefits; current assets are expected to be consumed within 12 months, whereas non-current assets are used for more than one accounting period. 资产是企业拥有或他人欠企业、能带来未来经济利益的价值项目；流动资产通常在 12 个月内消耗或变现，非流动资产则供企业使用超过一个会计期间。

entries.t: 📌 Liabilities — Current vs Non-Current（负债：流动与非流动）
entries.b: Liabilities — Current vs Non-Current（负债：流动与非流动） Liabilities are financial obligations the business owes to outside parties other than its owners; current liabilities are short-term obligations due within 12 months (e.g. Accounts Payable), while non-current liabilities extend beyond 12 months (e.g. Bank Loans). 负债是企业欠外部债权人（非老板）的财务义务；流动负债是 12 个月内到期的短期债务（如应付账款），非流动负债是超过 12 个月的长期债务（如长期银行贷款）。

entries.t: 📌 Revenue, Expenses & Owner’s Equity（收入、费用与所有者权益）
entries.b: Revenue, Expenses & Owner’s Equity（收入、费用与所有者权益） Revenue represents income earned by the business; expenses are costs or resources consumed in generating revenue; Owner’s Equity (Net Assets) is what belongs to the owner, increased by Capital and Net Profit and decreased by Drawings. 收入是企业赚取的收益；费用是为经营和创收而消耗的成本资源；所有者权益（净资产）归老板所有，投入资本和净利润使其增加，提款使其减少。

entries.t: 📌 Expanded Accounting Equation（扩展会计等式）
entries.b: Expanded Accounting Equation（扩展会计等式） The basic equation Assets = Liabilities + Owner’s Equity expands to Assets = Liabilities + Capital + Revenue − Expenses − Drawings, where Revenue − Expenses calculates Net Profit or Loss. 基本等式「资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益」可扩展为「资产 = 负债 + 资本 + 收入 − 费用 − 提款」，其中「收入 − 费用」决定本期净利润或净亏损。

entries.t: 📌 Rules of Double Entry（复式记账借贷规则）
entries.b: Rules of Double Entry（复式记账借贷规则） Every transaction affects at least two accounts with equal total debits and credits: Debit (Dr) increases Assets, Expenses and Drawings, while Credit (Cr) increases Liabilities, Owner’s Equity (Capital) and Revenue. 复式记账要求每笔交易至少影响两个账户且借贷金额相等：借方（Dr）增加资产、费用与提款（DEAD），贷方（Cr）增加负债、资本与收入（CLIC）。

entries.t: 🎯 Why must a business classify its assets and liabilities into Current and Non-Current categories?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 2 · 必考大题
entries.b: Why must a business classify its assets and liabilities into Current and Non-Current categories? 为什么企业必须把资产和负债划分为「流动（Current）」与「非流动（Non-Current）」两类？ accounting standards liquidity / meet debts as they fall due working capital planning First, classification is required by accounting regulations and reporting standards to ensure comparable financial statements. 第一，会计准则与法规明确要求这样分类，以保证不同企业报表具备可比性。 Second, it assists business planning by showing how much liquid (cash-convertible) assets are available to pay short-term debts as they fall due. 第二，便于评估短期偿债能力（流动性）——看清未来 12 个月内有多少可快速变现的流动资产来还到期短债。 Third, it distinguishes long-term productive investments (non-current assets) and long-term financing fro

entries.t: 🎯 Explain the difference between Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable, and state which accounting element each belongs to.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 2 · 必考大题
entries.b: Explain the difference between Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable, and state which accounting element each belongs to. 请区分应收账款（Accounts Receivable）与应付账款（Accounts Payable），并说明各自属于哪类会计要素。 Debtors / Current Asset Creditors / Current Liability credit sales vs credit purchases Accounts Receivable (Debtors) represent amounts owed TO the business by customers who bought goods or services on credit; they are classified as a Current Asset. 应收账款（债务人）是客户赊购商品/服务后「欠企业的钱」，将在短期内收回，属于流动资产（Current Asset）。 Accounts Payable (Creditors) represent amounts owed BY the business to suppliers for credit purchases; they are classified as a Current Liability. 应付账款（债权人）是企业赊购存货或服务后「欠供应商的钱」，属于流动负债（Current Liability

entries.t: 🎯 Why is the owner’s withdrawal of cash (Drawings) not recorded as a business Expense?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 2 · 必考大题
entries.b: Why is the owner’s withdrawal of cash (Drawings) not recorded as a business Expense? 为什么老板从企业取走现金（Drawings 提款）不能记为企业的费用（Expense）？ not incurred to generate revenue Accounting Entity reduces Owner’s Equity directly Expenses are costs incurred in operating the business to generate revenue, whereas Drawings are personal withdrawals of capital or profit by the owner. 费用是为了企业正常经营和创收而消耗的成本，而提款是老板拿回个人资金或分配利润，与创收无关。 Recording Drawings as an expense would violate the Accounting Entity Convention and artificially understate Net Profit on the Income Statement. 若把提款记为费用，既违反会计主体惯例，又会人为压低利润表上的净利润。 Therefore, Drawings directly reduce Owner’s Equity on the Balance Sheet (Dr Drawings, Cr Cash). 因此提款只直接扣减资产负债表

entries.t: 🎯 Compare Periodic and Perpetual inventory recording systems.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 2 · 必考大题
entries.b: Compare Periodic and Perpetual inventory recording systems. 请比较定期盘存制（Periodic）与永续盘存制（Perpetual）两种存货记录方式。 specific intervals / physical stocktake updated continuously real-time COGS Under a Periodic system, inventory records are updated only at specific intervals (e.g. monthly or annually) through a physical stocktake, and purchases are recorded in a Purchases account. 定期盘存制只在月末或年末通过实地盘点统一更新存货余额，平时进货记入 Purchases 账户。 Under a Perpetual system, inventory and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) are updated continuously after every single purchase and sale, providing real-time stock control. 永续盘存制在每一笔购进和销售发生时实时更新存货账和销货成本（COGS），库存管控更及时精准。

entries.t: 📖 二、Core Concepts（核心概念）
entries.b: 二、Core Concepts（核心概念） Expenses are costs of resources consumed in operating the business and earning revenue; they reduce profit and owner’s equity. Revenue is business income that increases profit and owner’s equity. A chart of accounts lists and codes accounts by element for identification and ordering. An account records increases and decreases in a specific item. An account records increases and decreases in one specific item. Account ：账户记录某个具体项目的增减。 The chart of accounts lists and codes accounts by element to support identification and ordering. Chart of accounts ：按要素列账户并编码，方便识别及排序。 Revenue increases profit and owner’s equity. Revenue ：企业收入增加利润及权益。 Expenses are the costs of resources consumed in operating the business and earning revenue; they reduce profit and owner’s equity. Expenses ：经营及赚取收入消耗的成本，减少利润及权益。

entries.t: 📌 General Journal（普通日记账）
entries.b: General Journal（普通日记账） The General Journal is the book of original (first) entry where business transactions are recorded in chronological order directly from source documents before posting to the ledger. 普通日记账是「原始分录簿（第一本账）」，按时间先后顺序依据原始凭证记录每笔交易，随后再过入分类账。

entries.t: 📌 Structure of a Journal Entry（标准分录格式）
entries.b: Structure of a Journal Entry（标准分录格式） Every journal entry must include the transaction date, the debited account(s) listed first on the left, the credited account(s) indented below, equal debit and credit dollar amounts, and a brief narration. 每条标准日记账分录必须包含：交易日期、靠左列示在上的借方科目、向右缩进列示在下的贷方科目、借贷相等的金额，以及简明的摘要（Narration）。

entries.t: 📌 Narration（分录摘要）
entries.b: Narration（分录摘要） A narration is a short explanation written below each journal entry that describes the nature of the transaction and cites the relevant source document for future audit and reference. 摘要是写在分录下方括号里的简短说明，记录交易事由及对应的发票/凭证号，方便日后查账与审计。

entries.t: 📌 Compound Journal Entry（复合分录）
entries.b: Compound Journal Entry（复合分录） A compound journal entry involves three or more accounts in a single transaction (for example, buying equipment partly with cash and partly on credit), while total debits still strictly equal total credits. 复合分录指一笔交易同时涉及三个或以上账户（如买设备一半付现金、一半赊账），但所有借方合计数仍严格等于贷方合计数。

entries.t: 🎯 Why do accountants record transactions in a General Journal first instead of entering them directly into ledger accounts?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 3 · 必考大题
entries.b: Why do accountants record transactions in a General Journal first instead of entering them directly into ledger accounts? 为什么会计要先记「普通日记账（General Journal）」，而不是直接把交易记进分类账（Ledger）？ chronological order complete effect in one place prevents errors audit trail The General Journal shows the complete effect of each transaction (both debit and credit sides) in one place in chronological order. 日记账按时间顺序把每笔交易的完整借贷双方集中展示在同一处，一眼看清来龙去脉。 It reduces posting errors by allowing accountants to verify that Debits equal Credits before transferring entries to separate ledger accounts. 先在日记账核对借贷相等再过入不同分类账，可大幅减少漏记一侧或借贷不等的过账错误。 Its narration links each entry back to the source document, forming an essential audit tr

entries.t: 🎯 What are the four most common formatting mistakes students lose marks for in General Journal exam questions?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 3 · 必考大题
entries.b: What are the four most common formatting mistakes students lose marks for in General Journal exam questions? 在考试写 General Journal 分录时，哪四个格式细节最容易被扣分？ date indent credit narration standard account titles Omitting dates, failing to indent credit account names, omitting the brief narration, or using informal names instead of standard account titles. 常见四大扣分点：漏写日期、贷方科目未向右缩进、忘写摘要（Narration），以及未用标准科目名（如写 "Car" 而不是 "Motor Vehicle"）。 Always double-check that total debits equal total credits for every single journal entry before moving on. 每写完一笔分录务必立刻口算借贷总额相等。

entries.b: 二、Core Concepts（核心概念） A complete entry includes the date, debit and credit accounts/amounts and narration. Record trade discounts only through the net invoice amount. For settlement discounts, use Discount Received or Discount Allowed according to the business’s buyer/seller viewpoint. 完整分录包括日期、借贷账户金额与narration。商业折扣仅记录净发票额；结算折扣按企业视角分别记录Discount Received或Discount Allowed。

entries.t: 📌 Accrual Basis vs Cash Basis（权责发生制 vs 收付实现制）
entries.b: Accrual Basis vs Cash Basis（权责发生制 vs 收付实现制） Under Accrual Accounting, revenues are recognised when earned and expenses when incurred regardless of when cash changes hands, ensuring accurate profit measurement for each accounting period. 权责发生制要求收入在「赚取时」确认、费用在「发生时」确认，不管现金何时收付，从而准确计量每个会计期间的真实利润。

entries.t: 📌 Prepaid Expenses & Unearned Revenue（预付费用与预收收入）
entries.b: Prepaid Expenses & Unearned Revenue（预付费用与预收收入） Prepaid expenses are cash paid in advance for future benefits (recorded as a Current Asset and expensed as used); unearned revenue is cash received before performing services (recorded as a Current Liability until earned). 预付费用是先付钱后受益（先记流动资产，期末按已消耗部分转费用）；预收收入是先收钱后干活（先记流动负债，提供服务后再转收入）。

entries.t: 📌 Depreciation & Accumulated Depreciation（折旧与累计折旧）
entries.b: Depreciation & Accumulated Depreciation（折旧与累计折旧） Depreciation allocates the cost of a non-current asset over its useful life due to wear and tear or obsolescence; Accumulated Depreciation is a contra-asset account with a normal credit balance offset against the asset on the Balance Sheet. 折旧将非流动资产的成本在其使用寿命内分摊为费用；「累计折旧」是资产备抵账户（Contra Asset），正常余额在贷方，在资产负债表上直接扣减原值得到账面净值。

entries.t: 📌 Accrued Revenue（应计收入）
entries.b: Accrued Revenue（应计收入） Accrued revenues are revenues that have been earned during the period, but cash payment has not yet been received, requiring an adjusting entry: Dr Receivable, Cr Revenue. 应计收入是本期已经赚取（服务已完成或利息已产生）但期末尚未收到现金的收入，期末调整分录为：借 应收类资产，贷 收入。

entries.t: 📌 Accrued Expenses（应计费用）
entries.b: Accrued Expenses（应计费用） Accrued expenses are expenses that have been incurred in the period, but payment has not yet been made, requiring an adjusting entry to record both the Expense (Dr) and a Payable liability (Cr). 应计费用是本期已经发生（如已用电力、员工已上班）但期末尚未付款的费用，期末必须补记：借 费用，贷 应付类负债。

entries.t: 🎯 Why are adjusting entries required at the end of an accounting period, and why do they never involve the Cash account?

entries.b: Why are adjusting entries required at the end of an accounting period, and why do they never involve the Cash account? 为什么会计期末必须做调整分录（Adjusting Entries）？为什么调整分录永远不会涉及现金（Cash）账户？ Accrual Basis matching principle never involves Cash 1 Income Statement + 1 Balance Sheet Adjusting entries are required under the Accrual Basis and Accounting Period conventions to ensure all revenues earned and expenses incurred in the current period are properly matched before financial statements are prepared. 依据权责发生制与会计分期惯例，期末必须通过调整分录把属于本期的收入与费用精准配比，报表利润才真实。 They never involve Cash because cash was either already exchanged in an earlier transaction (prepayments/unearned revenue) or will be exchanged in a future

entries.t: 🎯 Explain what happens to Net Profit, Assets and Liabilities if an accountant forgets to record an Accrued Expense of $1,500 at year-end.

entries.t: 📌 General Ledger（总分类账）
entries.b: General Ledger（总分类账） A General Ledger is a comprehensive record of all accounts within a business, from which the Trial Balance and Financial Statements are prepared. 总分类账是企业全部账户的汇总记录簿，是编制试算平衡表和三大财务报表的直接数据来源。

entries.t: 📌 Posting from Journal to Ledger（过账规则）
entries.b: Posting from Journal to Ledger（过账规则） Posting transfers each debit and credit from the General Journal to the matching side of the respective T-account, writing the dollar amount and the name of the opposite (cross-reference) account. 过账是将日记账中的借方与贷方逐笔搬到对应 T 型账户的相同方向（借过左、贷过右），摘要栏填写「对方科目名称」。

entries.t: 📌 Balancing T-Accounts: Balance c/d & b/d（T 型账户结平）
entries.b: Balancing T-Accounts: Balance c/d & b/d（T 型账户结平） To balance a T-account at period-end, sum the larger side, insert the difference on the smaller side as Balance c/d (carried down / closing balance), double-underline equal totals, and open next period on the larger side with Balance b/d (brought down). 结平 T 型账户时，先加总金额较大的一侧，在较小一侧补写差额作为「期末结转余额 Balance c/d」，画双下划线后，在「较大一侧」下方写下期期初「Balance b/d」。

entries.t: 📌 Debit Balance vs Credit Balance（借方余额与贷方余额）
entries.b: Debit Balance vs Credit Balance（借方余额与贷方余额） If the debit side total exceeds the credit side total, the account has a Debit Balance (normal for Assets and Expenses); if credit exceeds debit, it has a Credit Balance (normal for Liabilities, Equity and Revenue). 借方合计大于贷方合计时称为「借方余额」（资产与费用的正常余额）；贷方合计大于借方合计时称为「贷方余额」（负债、权益与收入的正常余额）。

entries.t: 🎯 Explain the difference between Balance c/d and Balance b/d in a T-account, and explain why Balance c/d appears on the smaller side.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 5 · 必考大题
entries.b: Explain the difference between Balance c/d and Balance b/d in a T-account, and explain why Balance c/d appears on the smaller side. 请解释 T 型账户中 Balance c/d 与 Balance b/d 的区别，并说明为什么 Balance c/d 写在较小的一侧？ carried down = closing brought down = opening true balance sits on b/d side Balance c/d (carried down) is the closing balance at the end of the current period; it is placed on the smaller side purely to make both sides add up to the same total. Balance c/d 是本期末结转余额，写在较小一侧只是为了把左右两边补成相同总额。 Balance b/d (brought down) is the opening balance on the first day of the next period; it always sits on the LARGER side and indicates the account’s true debit or credit balance. Balance b/d 是下期第一天的期初余额，一定落在原本较

entries.t: 🎯 When posting Dr Cash $10,000 / Cr Capital $10,000 to the Cash T-account, why do we write "Capital" instead of "Cash" inside the Cash account?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 5 · 必考大题
entries.b: When posting Dr Cash $10,000 / Cr Capital $10,000 to the Cash T-account, why do we write "Capital" instead of "Cash" inside the Cash account? 将「借 Cash $10,000 / 贷 Capital $10,000」过入 Cash 的 T 型账户时，为什么 particulars 栏写的是 "Capital" 而不是 "Cash"？ cross-reference opposite account name traceability The account title at the top already identifies the Cash account, so writing the opposite account ("Capital") serves as a cross-reference showing WHERE the cash came from. 账户顶部的标题已经表明这是现金账，栏内写对方科目 "Capital" 作为交叉索引，一眼看出这笔现金来源于老板注资。 This cross-referencing lets accountants trace both halves of any double-entry transaction rapidly. 这种交叉索引让查账时能迅速在两个分类账之间定位同一笔复式分录的另一半。

entries.t: 🎯 Under what circumstances can a Cash at Bank account end up with a Credit Balance, and how is it classified on the Balance Sheet?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 5 · 必考大题
entries.b: Under what circumstances can a Cash at Bank account end up with a Credit Balance, and how is it classified on the Balance Sheet? 什么情况下银行存款（Cash at Bank）会出现「贷方余额」？它在资产负债表上应如何分类？ Bank Overdraft credit balance Current Liability A Cash at Bank account shows a credit balance when the business has withdrawn more money than deposited, resulting in a Bank Overdraft. 当企业支出的金额超过银行账户存款余额时，即形成银行透支（Bank Overdraft），此时账户呈贷方余额。 Because the business now owes money to the bank on short notice, a Bank Overdraft is classified as a Current Liability rather than a Current Asset. 因为此时企业倒欠银行短期资金，银行透支必须在资产负债表上列为「流动负债（Current Liability）」而非资产。

entries.t: 🎯 Outline the four steps to balance a T-format ledger account accurately.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 5 · 必考大题
entries.b: Outline the four steps to balance a T-format ledger account accurately. 请简述将 T 型分类账准确结平的四个步骤。 sum larger side Balance c/d on smaller side double underline Balance b/d next period Step 1: Total the larger side and write that total at the bottom of both sides. 第 1 步：加总较大一侧，并将该合计数同时写在左右两栏底部。 Step 2: Subtract the smaller side’s entries from that total to calculate Balance c/d on the smaller side (dated last day of the period). 第 2 步：用合计数减去较小侧已有金额，在较小侧填入期末日期的 Balance c/d。 Step 3–4: Draw single top / double bottom lines under both totals, then bring the balance down as Balance b/d on the larger side dated the first day of the next period. 第 3–4 步：在总计下方画双下划线封账，并在较大侧下方写下月初日期的 Balance b/d。

entries.t: 📖 Weekly Overview 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览）
entries.b: Weekly Overview 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览） At the ledger stage of the accounting cycle, Unit 6 practises posting journal entries to T-accounts and following the balancing procedure. Posting groups transactions by account so that balances can be calculated. Practise drawing the accounts, particularly the opposite placements of balance c/d and balance b/d. 会计循环第四站 ledgers。Unit 6 练习把日记账分录 posting 到 T 型账户，并掌握 balancing 的规范步骤。过账把分散在日记账中的交易按账户归集，才能算出各账户余额。T 型账户结构简单，但 balance c/d 与 balance b/d 的方向最容易出错，务必动手画一遍。

entries.t: 📖 Core Concepts 二、Core Concepts（核心概念）
entries.b: Core Concepts 二、Core Concepts（核心概念） The General Ledger is the complete collection of a business’s accounts and provides the account data for financial statements. general ledger （总分类账）：包含企业全部账户，是财务报表的数据来源 Posting is the process of transferring journal information to the corresponding ledger accounts. posting （过账）：把日记账信息转入分类账对应账户的过程 A T-format account has its name above the T, debits on the left and credits on the right, with Date, Particulars and Amount on each side. T-format account （T 型账户）：左借右贷，上方为账户名，含 date、particulars、金额三列 Balance c/d is the period-end difference entered on the smaller side to balance the account. Balance b/d is the same amount brought forward on the larger side at the beginning of the next period. balance c/d （结转余额）：期末记在较小一侧的轧差额； balance b/d （期初余额）：下期初记在较大一侧

entries.t: 📖 Key Details & Steps 三、Key Details & Steps（重点详解与步骤）
entries.b: Key Details & Steps 三、Key Details & Steps（重点详解与步骤） Post in this order: locate the account, choose the debit/credit side, enter the amount, write the corresponding account in Particulars and enter the date. Following the sequence consistently helps avoid omissions. 过账规则：找账户 → 看借贷方向 → 先写金额 → particulars 写对方账户名 → 写日期，五个动作顺序固定，形成肌肉记忆后就不会漏。 Total each side, enter the larger total on both sides, put the difference on the smaller side as balance c/d, rule the totals and bring the amount down on the opposite side as balance b/d on the first day of the next month. 结账六步：分别加总借贷两边 → 较大总额写在两侧 → 较小一侧差额记 balance c/d → 两侧总额划线 → 下月首日把余额过到反方向记 balance b/d。 Assets, expenses and Drawings normally have debit balances; liabilities, equity and revenue normally have credit balances. These sides correspond to the trial balance’s debit and credit columns. 正常余额方向：assets、expenses、drawings 为 debit accounts；liabiliti

entries.t: 📖 Common Mistakes & Confusions 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点）
entries.b: Common Mistakes & Confusions 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点） Do not reverse the c/d and b/d sides, which would misstate next period’s balance. Distinguishing their placement is a central T-account balancing skill. b/d 与 c/d 写反方向，导致下期余额错误；这是 T 型账户结账的第一大错。 Include the corresponding account in Particulars so that entries can be cross-referenced and traced back to their transactions. particulars 漏写对方账户名，账目无法交叉索引，追溯交易来龙去脉会变困难。 Check that both side totals agree and are double-ruled after balancing. Missing rules or unequal totals should be corrected. 两侧总额忘划双线或金额不一致；结账后两侧总额必须相等，这是自检的第一步。 The closing balance appears as b/d at the start of the next period. c/d and b/d have the same amount but different sides, positions and dates; distinguish the balancing presentation from the underlying balance. 把 closing balance 与 c/d 混为一谈：closing balance 在下期初以 b/d 形式出现；两者金额相同、方向和位置不同。

entries.b: Bridging & Looking Ahead 五、Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下） Unit 7 introduces columnar accounts, updating the balance after each transaction and using those balances to prepare a trial balance for financial statements. The retained guidance also asks you to open Week 5’s Excel workbook to practise the spreadsheet environment. 下周 Unit 7 换成 columnar format，余额随每笔交易连续更新，并在此基础上编制 trial balance，为财务报表做准备。请同时打开 week5 的 Excel workbook 练习，提前熟悉电子表格环境。

entries.b: 总分类账与 T 形账户（General Ledger & T-format） unit6 lecture slides t-format.pdf · PDF p3–23；unit6 reading materials ledger accounts t-format.pdf · PDF p1–3 概念 日记账 按时间记下每笔交易； 总分类账 （general ledger）把同一账户的变动集中在一起，是编报表的依据。 T 形账户 ：账户名在顶上， 左借右贷 ，每边有日期、摘要（particulars）、金额三栏。 过账五步 ：①找到账户；②看记借方还是贷方；③先写金额；④摘要栏写 对方账户 ；⑤写日期。 例 1（Lecture Ex 1） Post the journal entries (Feb 1 Cash 10 000 / Capital；Feb 6 Office furniture 5 000 / A/P – Fantastic；Feb 13 A/R – Barry 100 / Sales；Feb 22 Cash 100 / A/R – Barry；Feb 25 A/P – Fantastic 1 000 / Cash) to T-format ledger accounts. 看解答 每笔分录过两次：借方账户记左边、摘要写贷方账户名；贷方账户记右边、摘要写借方账户名。课件这一页只过账，不结账。 Cash at Bank Date Particulars Dr $ Dat

entries.t: 📌 Running-Balance (Columnar) Ledger（多栏式/三栏式分类账）
entries.b: Running-Balance (Columnar) Ledger（多栏式/三栏式分类账） A columnar (running-balance) ledger displays Debit, Credit and Balance columns side by side so that the updated account balance is visible immediately after every single transaction. 多栏式（三栏式）分类账把借方、贷方与余额并列排布，每过入一笔交易就立刻算出最新余额，比 T 型账户更便于日常实时查询。

entries.t: 📌 Trial Balance（试算平衡表）
entries.b: Trial Balance（试算平衡表） A Trial Balance is a list of all General Ledger accounts and their debit or credit balances at a specific date, prepared to test the mathematical equality of total debits and total credits. 试算平衡表是在特定日期汇总所有分类账账户及借贷余额的清单，用于检验总账借方合计与贷方合计在算术上是否相等。

entries.t: 📌 Limitations of a Trial Balance（试算平衡表的局限性）
entries.b: Limitations of a Trial Balance（试算平衡表的局限性） A balanced Trial Balance proves only arithmetical accuracy (ΣDr = ΣCr); it cannot detect six classes of hidden errors: Omission, Principle, Commission, Original Entry, Complete Reversal, and Compensating errors. 试算平衡表配平只能证明「借贷算术相等」，无法查出六类隐蔽错误：遗漏、原理错误、串户、原始金额错误、借贷颠倒与抵消错误。

entries.t: 📌 Locating Trial Balance Discrepancies（试算不平的排查法）
entries.b: Locating Trial Balance Discrepancies（试算不平的排查法） When debits and credits do not equal, accountants check column additions, look for a missing balance equal to the difference, divide the difference by 2 (a balance placed on the wrong side), or check divisibility by 9 (transposition error). 试算不平时按序排查：重加总计 → 查是否漏抄恰好等于差额的账户 → 差额除以 2 查是否借贷写反 → 差额能被 9 整除则重点查相邻数字写颠倒（如 54 写成 45）。

entries.t: 🎯 Why does an agreed (balanced) Trial Balance not guarantee that the accounting records are completely free of errors? Explain any four errors not revealed by a Trial Balance.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 6 · 必考大题
entries.b: Why does an agreed (balanced) Trial Balance not guarantee that the accounting records are completely free of errors? Explain any four errors not revealed by a Trial Balance. 为什么试算平衡表借贷配平也不能保证账簿完全没有错误？请解释其中任意四类查不出的错误。 arithmetical equality only Omission Principle Commission Original Entry / Reversal A Trial Balance only checks arithmetical equality of debits and credits; any error that affects both sides equally still leaves totals balanced. 总论：试算平衡表只验算术借贷相等，只要错误同时等额影响借贷双方，总计照样会平。 Error of Omission (entire transaction left out) and Error of Principle (recording an asset purchase as an expense, violating accounting rules). 遗漏错误（整笔漏记）与原理错误（把买设备资产错记成维修费用，性质归错但借贷仍平）。 Error of Commission (posting

entries.t: 🎯 Compare T-format ledger accounts with Columnar (running-balance) ledger accounts. Which is preferred in computerised accounting and why?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 6 · 必考大题
entries.b: Compare T-format ledger accounts with Columnar (running-balance) ledger accounts. Which is preferred in computerised accounting and why? 请比较 T 型账户与多栏式（三栏式）分类账，说明现代电算化会计为何普遍采用多栏式。 periodic balancing running balance after every transaction real-time visibility T-accounts group debits on the left and credits on the right and require periodic balancing to find the ending balance, making them ideal for teaching and quick sketches. T 型账户左右分栏，需到期末结平才能算出余额，直观简洁，适合教学与草稿分析。 Columnar ledgers update the running balance after every single transaction, which is preferred in computerised software because managers can inspect real-time balances immediately. 多栏式账页每记一笔就自动刷新最新余额，电算化软件普遍采用，方便管理层随时查看实时现金与应收余额。

entries.t: 🎯 A Trial Balance shows Debit total $48,200 and Credit total $47,840 (difference $360). Describe two systematic checks to locate the mistake.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 6 · 必考大题
entries.b: A Trial Balance shows Debit total $48,200 and Credit total $47,840 (difference $360). Describe two systematic checks to locate the mistake. 试算平衡表借方合计 $48,200、贷方合计 $47,840（差额 $360）。请写出两种系统排查该差错的方法。 divide by 2 = wrong column divisible by 9 = transposition error Divide the difference by 2 ($360 ÷ 2 = $180): check whether a $180 credit balance was mistakenly listed in the Debit column. 将差额除以 2（$180）：重点查找是否把一笔 $180 的贷方余额错抄进了借方栏（导致借方多 180、贷方少 180，相差 360）。 Since $360 is divisible by 9, check for a transposition error (two adjacent digits swapped, such as $730 written as $370) or a slide error (missing a zero). 因 $360 能被 9 整除，同时排查数字颠倒错（如 $730 抄成 $370）或漏写零的错位错误。

entries.t: 🎯 Explain the purpose of an Adjusted Trial Balance compared to an Unadjusted Trial Balance.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 6 · 必考大题
entries.b: Explain the purpose of an Adjusted Trial Balance compared to an Unadjusted Trial Balance. 请说明「调整后试算平衡表」与「调整前试算平衡表」的区别与作用。 before vs after adjusting entries direct basis for financial statements An Unadjusted Trial Balance checks ledger equality after routine daily postings but BEFORE period-end adjusting entries (prepayments, accruals, depreciation) are recorded. 调整前试算表检验日常过账的借贷平衡，但尚未计入预付、应计和折旧等期末调整。 An Adjusted Trial Balance is prepared AFTER posting adjusting entries and serves as the direct, accurate basis for preparing the Income Statement and Balance Sheet. 调整后试算表在过入全部调整分录后编制，验证依然配平后，直接用于编制利润表和资产负债表。

entries.t: 📖 Weekly Overview 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览）
entries.b: Weekly Overview 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览） Unit 7 first practises columnar accounts, updating the balance with each entry, and then prepares the trial balance as a step towards financial statements. A trial balance detects some errors, but cannot detect every error; the retained study guidance highlights this limitation for revision. Unit 7 上半场练习 columnar format 账户：每记一笔就更新一次 balance，随时掌握账户最新动态；下半场正式编制 trial balance，作为财务报表的前置关卡。试算平衡能查错，但查不全，这一点考试常考。

entries.t: 📖 Core Concepts 二、Core Concepts（核心概念）
entries.b: Core Concepts 二、Core Concepts（核心概念） A columnar account contains Date, Particulars, Dr, Cr and Balance columns. Update the balance after each entry and label it Dr or Cr. columnar format （多栏式账户）：Date、Particulars、Dr、Cr、Balance 五列，余额连续更新并标注 Dr 或 Cr A trial balance lists all General Ledger account balances; total debits should equal total credits. trial balance （试算平衡表）：列示总分类账全部账户余额的报表，借方合计应等于贷方合计 A contra account has the opposite balance side to the account it offsets; Accumulated Depreciation is an example. contra account （抵减账户）：余额方向与正常相反，如累计折旧

entries.t: 📖 Key Details & Steps 三、Key Details & Steps（重点详解与步骤）
entries.b: Key Details & Steps 三、Key Details & Steps（重点详解与步骤） Columnar accounts provide a continually updated balance. At period end, use the final account balance in the trial balance. 多栏式账户的优势是随时有余额，结账时只需把最后余额抄进试算平衡表即可。 Post in six steps: locate the account, choose Dr or Cr, enter the amount, write the corresponding account in Particulars, enter the date, then update Balance and mark it Dr or Cr. 多栏式记账六步：找账户 → 定 Dr / Cr 列 → 写金额 → particulars 写对方账户 → 写日期 → 更新 Balance 列并注明 Dr 或 Cr。 Add entries on the same side as the existing balance and subtract entries on the opposite side. For example, 10,000 Dr + 2,500 Dr = 12,500 Dr; subtracting 3,000 Cr gives 9,500 Dr. 余额更新规则：余额与下笔同向则加，反向则减，如 10,000 Dr + 2,500 Dr = 12,500 Dr，再 − 3,000 Cr = 9,500 Dr。 Prepare a trial balance by listing accounts, placing normal asset/expense/Drawings balances in Debit and liability/equity/revenue balances in Credit, totalling ea

entries.t: 📖 Common Mistakes & Confusions 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点）
entries.b: Common Mistakes & Confusions 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点） Label the Balance column Dr or Cr. Omitting the side makes the balance ambiguous and may place it in the wrong trial-balance column. Balance 列漏标 Dr / Cr，无法判断余额方向，汇总进试算平衡表时就会放错栏。 An agreeing trial balance can still contain complete omissions, incorrect accounts such as Telephone instead of Electricity, equal number errors on both sides or a complete reversal of debit/credit directions. 试算表平衡不等于无误：omission、记错账户（如电费记成电话费）、数字错位、借贷方向整体写反，借贷金额仍然相等，都不会破坏平衡。 Include contra accounts such as Accumulated Depreciation on the credit side. The retained warning below states that omitting an account causes disagreement; this assumes a non-zero balance without an offsetting omission. accumulated depreciation 等 contra 账户余额在贷方列示，别漏；遗漏任何账户都会导致两侧不等。 T-format and columnar accounts are alternative presentations with the same final results. P

entries.t: 📖 Bridging & Looking Ahead 五、Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）
entries.b: Bridging & Looking Ahead 五、Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下） The retained course sequence identifies Week 7 as mid-term revision and Week 8 as the start of financial statements with the Income Statement. Practise the journal → ledger → trial balance chain linking transactions to reports. Week 7 为期中复习周，没有新课；Week 8 起进入财务报表阶段，从 income statement 开始，请把 journal → ledger → trial balance 这条链路练熟，它是从记账通往报表的桥。

entries.t: 📊 多栏式账户（Columnar Format）
entries.b: 多栏式账户（Columnar Format） unit7 lecture slides column format & tb.pdf · PDF p4–12；unit7 reading materials columnar & trial balance.pdf · PDF p1–3；unit5a practice balancing an account (columnar).pdf · PDF p1–2；unit7 tutorial guide columnar & tb.pdf · PDF p2–7 概念 多栏式账户的栏目：日期、摘要（对方账户）、借方、贷方、 余额 ，余额后写 Dr 或 Cr。 每过一笔就更新余额 ：余额在借方时，再来借方就加、来贷方就减；余额在贷方时相反。最后一行的余额就是期末余额，不需要像 T 形账户那样另做 c/d、b/d。 过账步骤：①找账户；②看记在借方栏还是贷方栏；③先写金额；④摘要写对方账户；⑤写日期；⑥算出余额并标 Dr/Cr。 与 T 形格式的区别：日期、摘要只有一栏，借贷并排，多一栏随时更新的余额；结果与 T 形账户相同。 例 1（Tutorial Terms） Explain: Columnar format; Trial balance. 看解答 Columnar format ：多栏式账户，栏目为日期、摘要、借方、贷方、余额，每笔交易后更新余额并标明 Dr 或 Cr。 Trial balance ：试算平衡表，某一时点列出总分类账

entries.t: 📊 试算平衡表（Trial Balance）
entries.b: 试算平衡表（Trial Balance） unit7 lecture slides column format & tb.pdf · PDF p13–18；unit7 reading materials columnar & trial balance.pdf · PDF p4–5；unit7 tutorial guide columnar & tb.pdf · PDF p4–15 概念 试算平衡表 列出某一时点所有分类账账户的余额，用来检查借贷是否相等，是编报表前的准备。 编制：①列出全部账户；②资产、费用、提款的余额放借方栏；③负债、所有者权益、收入的余额放贷方栏；④两栏加总；⑤核对相等。抵减账户：Sales Returns、Discount Allowed 在借方，Purchase Returns、Discount Received、Accumulated Depreciation 在贷方。 局限 ：借贷仍然相等的错误查不出来——整笔漏记、记错账户、数字颠倒（同一错数记两边）、借贷方向整笔记反、整笔重复记录。 例 10（Lecture p17） Kingsford Trading trial balance (21 accounts): check that debit total equals credit total. 看解答 借方：1 940 + 3 110 + 3 500 + 30 + 104 + 21 800 + 0 + 740 + 9 700 + 26 + 25

entries.t: 📌 End-to-End Accounting Cycle Mastery（完整会计循环贯通）
entries.b: End-to-End Accounting Cycle Mastery（完整会计循环贯通） From identifying a transaction via a source document to journalising, posting to ledgers, balancing, preparing a Trial Balance and recording period-end adjustments, every step preserves the core identity Assets = Liabilities + Owner’s Equity. 从凭原始单据识别交易，到编分录、过账、结平、编试算表与期末调整，每一步都严格维护「资产 = 负债 + 所有者权益」的恒等关系。

entries.t: 📌 Accrual Profit vs Cash Movement（权责利润与现金流区分）
entries.b: Accrual Profit vs Cash Movement（权责利润与现金流区分） Mid-term exams frequently test whether students confuse cash inflows/outflows (such as loan borrowings, capital injections or drawings) with Revenue and Expenses. 期中考试最高频陷阱是把现金收付（如向银行借钱、老板注资、老板提款、买固定资产）错当成收入或费用。

entries.t: 📌 Normal Balance Verification（正常余额速检法）
entries.b: Normal Balance Verification（正常余额速检法） Checking normal balances (Dr for Assets, Expenses, Drawings; Cr for Liabilities, Capital, Revenue, Accumulated Depreciation) quickly spots reversed postings during exams. 熟记各类账户的正常余额方向（资产/费用/提款在借方；负债/资本/收入/累计折旧在贷方）能在考场 10 秒揪出写反的分录。

entries.t: 🎯 Trace how a single transaction — paying $2,400 cash for a 12-month insurance policy on 1 April (year-end 30 June) — flows through the entire accounting cycle.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 7 · 必考大题
entries.b: Trace how a single transaction — paying $2,400 cash for a 12-month insurance policy on 1 April (year-end 30 June) — flows through the entire accounting cycle. 请追踪一笔业务（4 月 1 日付现 $2,400 买 12 个月保险，6 月 30 日结账）如何走完整个会计循环。 initial asset recognition 3/12 expired = $600 Income Statement $600 vs Balance Sheet $1,800 On 1 April (Initial Entry): Dr Prepaid Insurance $2,400, Cr Cash $2,400 (recorded as a Current Asset, not an immediate expense). 4 月 1 日初始分录：借 Prepaid Insurance $2,400，贷 Cash $2,400（先记流动资产）。 On 30 June (Adjusting Entry for 3 months expired: 3/12 × $2,400 = $600): Dr Insurance Expense $600, Cr Prepaid Insurance $600. 6 月 30 日期末调整（已过 3 个月 = $600）：借 Insurance Expense $600，贷 Prepaid Insurance

entries.t: 🎯 Identify three transactions that increase Cash at Bank WITHOUT increasing Revenue.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 7 · 必考大题
entries.b: Identify three transactions that increase Cash at Bank WITHOUT increasing Revenue. 请举出三种「增加了银行存款（Cash），但没有增加收入（Revenue）」的商业交易。 Capital contribution Bank Loan Collection of Accounts Receivable / Unearned Revenue 1) Owner contributes capital in cash (Dr Cash, Cr Capital — increases Equity, not Revenue). 1）老板现金注资（借 Cash，贷 Capital —— 增加所有者权益而非收入）。 2) Business borrows a bank loan (Dr Cash, Cr Loan Payable — increases Liability). 2）向银行借款（借 Cash，贷 Loan Payable —— 增加负债）。 3) Customer pays an existing Accounts Receivable balance, or pays a deposit in advance (Unearned Revenue). 3）收回客户之前的应收账款，或收到客户预付定金（预收收入负债）。

entries.t: 📌 Purpose of the Income Statement（利润表的核心目的）
entries.b: Purpose of the Income Statement（利润表的核心目的） The Income Statement (Statement of Financial Performance) reports a business’s revenues, expenses and resulting Net Profit or Net Loss over a specific accounting period ("For the year ended..."). 利润表（财务绩效表）反映企业在一段特定会计期间（标题必须写 For the year/month ended...）的收入、费用及最终净利润或净亏损。

entries.t: 📌 Gross Profit & Cost of Goods Sold（毛利润与销货成本）
entries.q: Gross Profit & Cost of Goods Sold
entries.b: Gross Profit & Cost of Goods Sold（毛利润与销货成本） For a merchandising business, Gross Profit equals Net Sales minus Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), where COGS = Opening Inventory + Net Purchases − Closing Inventory. 对商贸企业而言，毛利润 = 净销售收入 − 销货成本（COGS）；定期盘存制下 COGS = 期初存货 + 净采购 − 期末存货。

entries.t: 📌 Operating Expenses & Net Profit（营业费用与净利润）
entries.b: Operating Expenses & Net Profit（营业费用与净利润） Operating expenses (such as Selling, Administrative and Financial expenses) are subtracted from Gross Profit plus Other Income to determine Net Profit, which is then transferred to Owner’s Equity. 营业费用（销售、管理与财务费用）从「毛利润 + 其他收入」中扣除后得到净利润，最终结转入所有者权益。

entries.t: 📌 Sales Returns & Freight-In vs Freight-Out（退货与进出运费）
entries.b: Sales Returns & Freight-In vs Freight-Out（退货与进出运费） Sales Returns reduce Sales Revenue to give Net Sales; Freight-In (delivery cost of buying inventory) is part of COGS, whereas Freight-Out (delivering goods to customers) is a Selling Expense. 销售退回直接冲减销售收入得到净销售额；购货运费（Freight-In）计入销货成本 COGS，而送货给客户的运费（Freight-Out）属于销售费用！

entries.t: 🎯 Distinguish between Gross Profit and Net Profit, and explain why a merchandising business might have a high Gross Profit but a low Net Profit.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 8 · 必考大题
entries.b: Distinguish between Gross Profit and Net Profit, and explain why a merchandising business might have a high Gross Profit but a low Net Profit. 请区分毛利润（Gross Profit）与净利润（Net Profit），并解释为什么一家商贸企业可能「毛利很高但净利很低」？ Net Sales - COGS operating overheads poor expense control Gross Profit (Net Sales − COGS) measures the core trading profit earned directly from buying and selling merchandise before overhead costs. 毛利润（净销售 − 销货成本）衡量商品买卖本身的直接加价盈利能力，尚未扣除日常运营开支。 Net Profit deducts all operating expenses (rent, wages, marketing, depreciation, interest) from Gross Profit plus other income. 净利润则是在毛利润加上其他收入后，进一步扣除全部房租、人工、营销、折旧与利息等营业费用后的最终盈余。 A firm can enjoy high Gross Profit yet low Net Profit if its operating

entries.t: 🎯 Given Sales $200,000, Sales Returns $5,000, Opening Inventory $20,000, Purchases $110,000, Freight-In $4,000, Closing Inventory $24,000 and Operating Expenses $55,000, calculate Net Sales, COGS, Gross Profit and Net Profit.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 8 · 必考大题
entries.b: Given Sales $200,000, Sales Returns $5,000, Opening Inventory $20,000, Purchases $110,000, Freight-In $4,000, Closing Inventory $24,000 and Operating Expenses $55,000, calculate Net Sales, COGS, Gross Profit and Net Profit. 已知销售 $200,000、退回 $5,000、期初存货 $20,000、采购 $110,000、进货运费 $4,000、期末存货 $24,000、营业费用 $55,000，求净销售、COGS、毛利和净利。 Net Sales $195,000 Freight-In inside COGS COGS $110,000 Net Profit $30,000 Net Sales = $200,000 − $5,000 = $195,000. 净销售收入 = 200,000 − 5,000 = $195,000。 COGS = Opening Inventory ($20,000) + Purchases ($110,000) + Freight-In ($4,000) − Closing Inventory ($24,000) = $110,000. 销货成本 COGS = 20,000 + 110,000 + 4,000 − 24,000 = $110,000（注意进货运费计入 COGS）。 Gross Profit = $195,000

entries.t: 🎯 Explain how Freight-In and Freight-Out are treated differently on the Income Statement.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 8 · 必考大题
entries.b: Explain how Freight-In and Freight-Out are treated differently on the Income Statement. 请解释进货运费（Freight-In）与销货运费（Freight-Out）在利润表中的处理有何不同。 Freight-In -> COGS Freight-Out -> Selling Expense Freight-In is the cost of bringing purchased inventory to the business premises, so it is added to Purchases inside Cost of Goods Sold (reducing Gross Profit). Freight-In 是把采购的商品运回仓库的必要成本，计入 COGS（直接影响毛利润）。 Freight-Out is the delivery cost of sending sold goods to customers, so it is classified as a Selling/Distribution Expense below Gross Profit. Freight-Out 是将已售商品配送给客户的费用，列在毛利润下方的销售/营业费用中。

entries.t: 🎯 Why must the Income Statement heading say "For the year ended 30 June 2026" instead of "As at 30 June 2026"?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 8 · 必考大题
entries.b: Why must the Income Statement heading say "For the year ended 30 June 2026" instead of "As at 30 June 2026"? 为什么利润表标题必须写 "For the year ended 30 June 2026"，而不能写 "As at 30 June 2026"？ period of time / flow As at = point in time (Balance Sheet) Because the Income Statement measures cumulative revenues and expenses earned and incurred OVER a period of time (a flow report), whereas "As at" refers to a single snapshot point in time (used for the Balance Sheet). 因为利润表汇总的是一整个时期内的流量（收入与费用累计发生额），必须用 "For the period ended..."；而 "As at..." 表示某一时点快照，只用于资产负债表。

entries.t: 📖 Weekly Overview 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览）
entries.b: Weekly Overview 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览） At the Reports stage of the accounting cycle, Unit 8 studies the structure and successive calculations of a classified Income Statement, with Excel practice. It reports what the business earned over a period, using trial-balance revenue and expense accounts in the required format. The retained overview particularly emphasises its relevance to external users. 会计循环抵达终点站 reports。Unit 8 学习 classified income statement 的完整结构与三层利润计算，并用 Excel 完成练习。利润表回答的是企业在一段时间内赚了多少，是外部使用者最关心的报表；它由 trial balance 中的收入与费用账户整理而成，格式必须按规范呈现。

entries.t: 📖 Core Concepts 二、Core Concepts（核心概念）
entries.b: Core Concepts 二、Core Concepts（核心概念） The Income Statement, also called the Profit and Loss Statement, reports revenues and expenses over a period and determines profit or loss. income statement （利润表，又称 profit and loss statement）：报告一定期间 revenues 与 expenses，得出 profit 或 loss COGS = Opening Stock + Net Purchases + Cartage In − Closing Stock. COGS （销售成本）：opening stock + net purchases + cartage in − closing stock Gross Profit = Net Sales − COGS. It measures the margin from trading goods before operating expenses. gross profit （毛利润）：net sales − COGS，只反映买卖差价 Net Profit = Gross Profit + Other Operating Income − Operating Expenses. net profit （净利润）：gross profit + other operating income − operating expenses Cartage In / Freight In is the cost of bringing goods into the business and forms part of COGS. cartage in / freight in （运入运费）：货物运入企业的成本，计入 COGS

entries.t: 📖 Key Details & Calculation Steps 三、Key Details & Calculation Steps（重点详解与计算步骤）
entries.b: Key Details & Calculation Steps 三、Key Details & Calculation Steps（重点详解与计算步骤） Build the Income Statement by calculating COGS, then Gross Profit and finally Net Profit in that sequence. 三步公式是利润表的骨架：先算销售成本，再算毛利润，最后算净利润，顺序不能颠倒。 Calculate COGS as Opening Inventory + Purchases − Purchase Returns + Cartage In − Closing Inventory. Omit a return or freight adjustment when the question gives none; do not invent an amount. COGS 计算顺序：期初存货 + 本期购货 − 购货退回 + 运入运费 − 期末存货；没有退回和运费的项目就跳过，不要硬凑。 Classify Operating Expenses as Selling and Distribution (advertising, sales wages and outward freight), General Administrative (office salaries, rent and depreciation), or Financial and Borrowing (interest, bad debts and bank charges) in the retained course grouping. Small businesses may not subdivide expenses, whereas larger businesses may present categories. operating expenses 三类：selling and distribution（广告、销售工资、运费）

entries.t: 📖 Common Mistakes & Confusions 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点）
entries.b: Common Mistakes & Confusions 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点） Opening Stock is added and Closing Stock is deducted in COGS. Reversing either sign misstates COGS and Gross Profit. closing stock 是减项，opening stock 是加项，方向写反则 COGS 全错，毛利润随之失真。 Purchase Returns reduce Purchases and Sales Returns reduce Sales. Do not apply one return to the other side of trading. purchase returns 与 sales returns 分别只影响 purchases 与 sales，不要交叉。 Net Sales = Sales − Sales Returns, not Sales plus Returns. Similarly, Purchase Returns reduce Purchases. net sales = sales − sales returns，不是 sales 加 returns；购货侧同理，退回都做冲减。 Discount Received is Other Operating Income, whereas Discount Allowed is an Operating Expense. Confusing them misstates the profit calculation; identify whether the business is buyer or seller first. discount received 计入 other operating income，discount allowed 计入 operating expenses，性质相反，记混会同时扭曲两层利润

entries.t: 📖 Bridging & Looking Ahead 五、Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下）
entries.b: Bridging & Looking Ahead 五、Bridging & Looking Ahead（承上启下） Unit 9 prepares the Balance Sheet, linked to the Income Statement through Net Profit. Review OE = Capital + Net Profit − Drawings and reconcile the corresponding figures between both reports. 下周 Unit 9 编制 balance sheet，与利润表通过 net profit 连接：利润增加 owner's equity，请复习 OE = capital + net profit − drawings 的关系，并想清楚两张报表的数字如何互相印证。

entries.t: 📊 财务报表与利润表的结构（Income Statement）
entries.q: 财务报表与利润表的结构（Income State
entries.b: 财务报表与利润表的结构（Income Statement） unit8 lecture slides fin stmnt 1 - income statement.pdf · PDF p3–20；unit8 reading materials income statement.pdf · PDF p1–3；unit8 tutorial guide income statement.pdf · PDF p2；introduction to excel.pdf · PDF p1–5 概念 三张报表： 利润表 （一段期间的收入、费用和利润）、 资产负债表 （某一时点的资产、负债、权益）、 现金流量表 （一段期间的现金流入流出）。 利润表的标题三行：企业名、报表名、期间（For the year ended …）。 净销售额 = Sales − Sales Returns。 销货成本 COGS = 期初存货 + 购货 − 购货退回（= 净购货）+ 运入费用（cartage/freight in）− 期末存货。 毛利 = 净销售额 − COGS，只反映买卖商品本身赚了多少。 净利润 = 毛利 + 其他经营收入（如 Discount Received）− 经营费用。 经营费用可分三类： 销售费用 （广告、销售人员工资、店面租金）、 管理费用 （办公室工资、水电、办公设备折旧）、 财务费用 （利息、Discount Allowed、坏账、银行手续费）。 格式：明细写在左栏，小计写在右栏，减项用

entries.t: 📌 Balance Sheet / Statement of Financial Position（资产负债表）
entries.q: Balance Sheet / Statement of Financial Position
entries.b: Balance Sheet / Statement of Financial Position（资产负债表） The Balance Sheet reports a business’s Assets, Liabilities and Owner’s Equity at a single specific point in time ("As at 30 June..."), demonstrating that Net Assets (Total Assets − Total Liabilities) equal Owner’s Equity. 资产负债表反映企业在某一特定日期（标题写 As at...）的资产、负债与所有者权益快照，展示「净资产（总资产 − 总负债）= 所有者权益」。

entries.t: 📌 Working Capital（营运资金）
entries.b: Working Capital（营运资金） Working Capital equals Current Assets minus Current Liabilities, measuring the short-term financial cushion available to fund day-to-day operations and pay upcoming bills. 营运资金 = 流动资产 − 流动负债，衡量企业维持日常周转并按期偿还短期债务的安全缓冲空间。

entries.t: 📌 Closing Owner’s Equity Linkage（期末权益勾稽公式）
entries.b: Closing Owner’s Equity Linkage（期末权益勾稽公式） Closing Owner’s Equity equals Opening Capital plus Additional Capital plus Net Profit (or minus Net Loss) minus Drawings, directly linking the Income Statement to the Balance Sheet. 期末所有者权益 = 期初资本 + 新增资本 + 净利润（或减净亏损）− 提款，这是把利润表与资产负债表严密勾稽起来的桥梁。

entries.t: 📌 Limitations of the Balance Sheet（资产负债表的局限性）
entries.b: Limitations of the Balance Sheet（资产负债表的局限性） Because assets are recorded at Historical Cost and non-monetary factors (such as brand reputation, staff skill or loyal customers) are excluded, a Balance Sheet does not show the true current market value of a business. 由于资产按历史成本入账，且无法以货币可靠计量的品牌声誉、员工技能、客户忠诚度不入表，资产负债表并不能直接等于企业的真实市场售价。

entries.t: 🎯 Explain how the Income Statement and the Balance Sheet are interconnected.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 9 · 必考大题
entries.q: Net Profit transferred to Owner’s Equity
entries.b: Explain how the Income Statement and the Balance Sheet are interconnected. 请说明利润表（Income Statement）与资产负债表（Balance Sheet）之间是如何相互勾稽联系的？ Net Profit transferred to Owner’s Equity Closing Capital = Net Assets Net Profit (or Net Loss) calculated at the bottom of the Income Statement is transferred into the Owner’s Equity section of the Balance Sheet. 利润表最终算出的净利润（或净亏损）会结转进资产负债表的所有者权益部分。 Specifically, Closing Capital = Opening Capital + Net Profit − Drawings, which must exactly equal Net Assets (Total Assets − Total Liabilities) for the Balance Sheet to balance. 具体公式为：期末权益 = 期初资本 + 净利润 − 提款，且该结果必须严格等于净资产（总资产 − 总负债），报表才能配平。

entries.t: 🎯 Why might a business with high Net Assets on its Balance Sheet still face a cash crisis? Explain using Current Assets and Working Capital.

entries.b: Why might a business with high Net Assets on its Balance Sheet still face a cash crisis? entries.t: 🎯 Outline two major limitations of the Balance Sheet for an investor wanting to buy a business.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 9 · 必考大题
entries.b: Outline two major limitations of the Balance Sheet for an investor wanting to buy a business. 对于想收购一家企业的投资者而言，资产负债表有哪两大主要局限性？ Historical Cost vs market value omission of non-monetary assets / goodwill 1) Historical Cost Valuation: Land and buildings are shown at original purchase price rather than current market value, which may greatly understate true worth. 1）历史成本计价：房产土地按多年前买价列示而非现行市价，可能严重低估真实价值。 2) Omission of Non-Monetary Assets: Internally generated goodwill, staff expertise and customer loyalty cannot be measured reliably in dollars and are omitted. 2）遗漏非货币软资产：员工能力、口碑、自创商誉等关键竞争力因难以货币计量而未体现在报表上。

entries.t: 🎯 Given Total Current Assets $45,000, Non-Current Assets $120,000, Current Liabilities $30,000, Non-Current Liabilities $50,000, Opening Capital $70,000 and Drawings $10,000, calculate Net Assets and Net Profit.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 9 · 必考大题
entries.b: Given Total Current Assets $45,000, Non-Current Assets $120,000, Current Liabilities $30,000, Non-Current Liabilities $50,000, Opening Capital $70,000 and Drawings $10,000, calculate Net Assets and Net Profit. 已知流动资产 $45,000、非流动资产 $120,000、流动负债 $30,000、非流动负债 $50,000、期初资本 $70,000、提款 $10,000，求净资产与本期净利润。 Net Assets $85,000 Closing Equity formula Net Profit $25,000 Total Assets = $45,000 + $120,000 = $165,000; Total Liabilities = $30,000 + $50,000 = $80,000. 总资产 = $165,000；总负债 = $80,000。 Net Assets (= Closing Equity) = $165,000 − $80,000 = $85,000. 净资产（即期末所有者权益）= 165,000 − 80,000 = $85,000。 Since Closing Equity = Opening Capital + Net Profit − Drawings → $85,000 = $70,000 + Net Profit − $10,000

entries.t: 📖 Weekly Overview 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览）
entries.b: Weekly Overview 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览） Unit 9 prepares a classified Balance Sheet: assets and liabilities are separated into current and non-current groups, and equity connects Capital, Net Profit and Drawings. It is a snapshot at one date rather than an accumulation over a period. Vertical format (A − L = OE) and account format (A = L + OE) present the same data. Unit 9 学习 classified balance sheet：把资产、负债按 current 与 non-current 分类列示，权益部分体现 capital、net profit 与 drawings 的关系。资产负债表是某一时点的快照，不是一段期间的累计；格式分 vertical（A − L = OE）与 account（A = L + OE）两种，数据完全相同。

entries.t: 📖 Core Concepts 二、Core Concepts（核心概念）
entries.b: Core Concepts 二、Core Concepts（核心概念） The Balance Sheet, also called the Statement of Financial Position, shows financial position at a specific date. balance sheet （资产负债表，又称 statement of financial position）：特定日期的财务状况快照 Current assets are cash and assets such as receivables, inventory and prepayments expected to be realised or consumed within a year; list them by liquidity in this presentation. current assets （流动资产）：现金、应收账款、存货、预付费用等一年内耗用或变现的资产，按流动性排序 Non-current assets include long-term Land, Buildings, Machinery and Motor Vehicles. Deduct the relevant Accumulated Depreciation when presenting depreciable assets at carrying amount. non-current assets （非流动资产）：land、buildings、machinery、motor vehicles 等长期资产，列示时扣除 accumulated depreciation，以净值进入报表 Net Assets = Total Assets − Total Liabilities and must equal Owner’s Equity. net assets （净资产）：total assets − total liabilities，应等于 owner's equity Owner

entries.t: 📖 Key Details & Presentation Order 三、Key Details & Presentation Order（重点详解与列示顺序）
entries.b: Key Details & Presentation Order 三、Key Details & Presentation Order（重点详解与列示顺序） Prepare Assets first, then Liabilities and Equity, recording each subtotal as you proceed and checking the totals at the end. 编制顺序建议先资产、再负债、后权益，每算一个小计立刻记下，最后核对总计。 List assets from greater to lower liquidity and liabilities from shorter to longer settlement periods. This helps users assess debt-paying pressure. 资产按流动性从高到低列示，负债按偿还期限从短到长列示，这种顺序帮助使用者快速判断偿付压力。 In Equity, start with opening Capital, add Net Profit and deduct Drawings to obtain total OE. Deduct a Net Loss instead; Drawings always reduces equity. 权益部分：期初 capital → add net profit → less drawings → total OE；net loss 则减少权益，提款永远减少权益。 Know both presentations: vertical format emphasises A − L = Net Assets = OE, whereas account format presents A = L + OE. Follow the format specified by the question. 两种格式都要会：vertical format 突出 A − L = Net Assets = OE；account

entries.b: Common Mistakes & Confusions 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点） Date a Balance Sheet “as at” and an Income Statement “for the year ended” or another appropriate period. The distinction is part of the required presentation. 资产负债表日期用 as at，利润表用 for the year ended，时态表述不要混，写错会被扣格式分。 Accumulated Depreciation is a contra asset, deducted beneath the related asset; it is not a liability. accumulated depreciation 是 contra asset，列在资产下方扣减，不是负债。 Take Net Profit from the Income Statement into the Balance Sheet’s Equity section and ensure both figures match. The Income Statement explains the period’s result and the Balance Sheet includes its effect on equity at the date. net profit 从利润表结转过来，两张表通过 OE 联动，数字必须一致；利润表是过程，资产负债表是结果。 Prepaid Expenses are current assets, paid before consumption. Unearned Revenue is a current liability, received before being earned. The timing and account types differ. pr

entries.b: 分类资产负债表（Classified Balance Sheet） unit9 lecture slides balance sheet.pdf · PDF p3–15；unit10 reading materials balance sheet.pdf · PDF p1–3；unit9 tutorial guide balance sheet.pdf · PDF p2–9；unit9 lecture exercise.xlsx · PDF Sheet1 概念 资产负债表反映 某一时点 的财务状况，标题写「as at 30 June 20XX」。 流动资产 ：现金、应收账款、期末存货、预付费用、物料，1 年或一个营业周期内变现或用掉。 非流动资产 ：土地、房屋、机器设备、车辆、家具，按成本列示并减去累计折旧。 流动负债 ：应付账款、应付工资、透支、应付利息、预收收入，1 年内偿还。 非流动负债 ：5 年期贷款、抵押贷款。 所有者权益 ：期初资本 + 净利润（亏损则减）− 提款。利润表的净利润就是这样连到资产负债表上的。 两种竖式格式：A = L + OE（资产合计等于负债加权益合计），或 A − L = 净资产 = OE。也可以用左右对照的 T 式。 利润表里的项目（收入、费用）不进资产负债表；资产负债表只用期末存货。 Assets = Liabilities + Owner's Equity Net Assets = Total Assets − Total Liabiliti

entries.b: Week 10 · Unit 10 财务报表分析 Financial statement analysis and ratio analysis Profitability ratios: ROE, ROA, net profit margin Liquidity ratios: current ratio and quick ratio Management efficiency: stock turnover and debtors turnover Solvency ratios: debt to equity and debt to assets Limitations of ratio analysis 计算四大类核心比率并正确解读其含义 用 trend 与 industry average 对比得出 favourable 或 unfavourable 结论 说明比率分析的固有局限

entries.t: 📌 Profitability Ratios（盈利能力比率）
entries.b: Profitability Ratios（盈利能力比率） Gross Profit Margin (GP ÷ Net Sales × 100%) measures pricing and purchasing efficiency, while Net Profit Margin (NP ÷ Net Sales × 100%) and Return on Equity (ROE = NP ÷ Average Equity) measure overall profit generated per dollar of sales or owner investment. 毛利率衡量商品定价与采购成本控制能力；净利率和净资产收益率（ROE）分别衡量每 $1 销售额和每 $1 老板投入最终赚回多少纯利润。

entries.t: 📌 Liquidity Ratios: Current vs Quick Ratio（短期偿债比率）
entries.q: Liquidity Ratios: Current vs Quick Ratio
entries.b: Liquidity Ratios: Current vs Quick Ratio（短期偿债比率） The Current Ratio (Current Assets ÷ Current Liabilities) measures overall short-term debt coverage, whereas the Quick (Acid-Test) Ratio [(CA − Inventory − Prepayments) ÷ CL] tests immediate liquidity without relying on selling inventory. 流动比率衡量短期资产覆盖短期债务的总倍数；速动比率剔除变现慢的存货与预付款，检验企业最紧急的即期偿债能力。

entries.t: 📌 Efficiency Ratios（营运效率比率）
entries.b: Efficiency Ratios（营运效率比率） Inventory Turnover (COGS ÷ Average Inventory) shows how quickly stock is sold, while Debtors Collection Period (Average AR ÷ Credit Sales × 365) shows how many days it takes on average to collect cash from credit customers. 存货周转率反映存货卖得有多快；应收账款回收天数反映赊销后平均需要几天把现金收回来。

entries.t: 📌 Solvency / Leverage Ratio（财务杠杆与长期偿债比率）
entries.b: Solvency / Leverage Ratio（财务杠杆与长期偿债比率） The Debt Ratio (Total Liabilities ÷ Total Assets × 100%) shows the proportion of assets financed by external creditors; higher leverage increases financial risk and interest commitments. 资产负债率（总负债 ÷ 总资产）反映企业有多少资产是靠借债买来的；杠杆越高，固定利息压力和财务违约风险越大。

entries.t: 🎯 Why is the Quick Ratio considered a stricter measure of short-term liquidity than the Current Ratio?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 10 · 必考大题
entries.b: Why is the Quick Ratio considered a stricter measure of short-term liquidity than the Current Ratio? 为什么速动比率（Quick Ratio）被视为比流动比率（Current Ratio）更严格的短期偿债指标？ excludes Inventory & Prepayments slow to convert into cash immediate liquidity The Quick Ratio excludes Inventory and Prepaid Expenses from Current Assets before dividing by Current Liabilities. 速动比率在分子中剔除了存货（Inventory）和预付费用（Prepayments）。 Inventory may be slow-moving or only sellable at a discount in an emergency, and prepayments cannot be turned back into cash to pay urgent creditors. 因为紧急情况下存货可能滞销或只能打折抛售，预付款也无法变回现金去还债，所以剔除后更能测出真实抗压能力。

entries.t: 🎯 A retailer’s Current Ratio rose from 1.8:1 to 2.9:1, while its Quick Ratio fell from 1.1:1 to 0.6:1. Diagnose what has happened and recommend two management actions.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 10 · 必考大题
entries.b: A retailer’s Current Ratio rose from 1.8:1 to 2.9:1, while its Quick Ratio fell from 1.1:1 to 0.6:1. Diagnose what has happened and recommend two management actions. 某零售商流动比率从 1.8:1 升至 2.9:1，但速动比率却从 1.1:1 跌至 0.6:1。请诊断原因并提出两条管理改进建议。 excessive inventory build-up clearance discounts tighter purchasing control Diagnosis: Because Current Ratio rose while Quick Ratio fell sharply, the business has accumulated excessive Inventory (stockpile) while its cash and receivables shrank. 诊断：流动比率升而速动比率大跌，唯一解释就是存货大量积压，占用了现金与速动资产。 Recommendation 1: Run targeted promotional discounts to clear slow-moving stock and convert inventory back into cash. 建议 1：对滞销商品开展促销清仓，加快存货周转回笼现金。 Recommendation 2: Tighten inventor

entries.t: 🎯 Explain why a single financial ratio calculated for one year is not meaningful on its own.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 10 · 必考大题
entries.b: Explain why a single financial ratio calculated for one year is not meaningful on its own. 为什么只算某一年、孤立的一个财务比率本身没有太大分析意义？ benchmarks trend over time industry averages budget targets A ratio needs benchmarks to interpret whether performance is strong or weak: horizontal trend comparison (against prior years), industry averages (competitors), and budgeted targets. 比率必须有参照基准才能判断好坏：纵向比（对比过去 2–3 年趋势）、横向比（对比同行业均值/竞争对手）以及对比预算目标。

entries.t: 🎯 How can a company improve its Gross Profit Margin without raising selling prices?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 10 · 必考大题
entries.b: How can a company improve its Gross Profit Margin without raising selling prices? 在不提高商品售价的前提下，企业可以通过哪些方式提高毛利率（Gross Profit Margin）？ lower COGS bulk discounts / cheaper suppliers reduce wastage / better product mix Since Gross Profit Margin = (Sales − COGS) ÷ Sales, the firm must lower Cost of Goods Sold by negotiating bulk purchase discounts, switching to more cost-effective suppliers, or reducing inventory wastage and theft. 毛利率 = (销售 − COGS) ÷ 销售；不涨价就必须降 COGS：与供应商谈批量折扣、更换更具性价比的货源、减少存货损耗与失窃，或提高高毛利产品销售占比。

entries.t: 📖 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览）
entries.b: 一、Weekly Overview（本周概览） English explanation (paraphrase): Unit 10 introduces financial statement analysis: use the financial statements to calculate ratios and assess profitability, liquidity, management efficiency and solvency. A ratio is not inherently good or bad; interpret it against a trend, industry average or target. Analysis highlights strengths and weaknesses but does not automatically identify their causes. 中文：Unit 10 学习 financial statement analysis：从报表数字出发计算比率，评估 profitability、liquidity、management efficiency 与 solvency 四个方面。比率本身没有绝对好坏，必须与 trend、industry average 或 target 比较才有意义；分析能指出强弱项，但不能自动告诉你原因。

entries.t: 📖 二、Core Concepts（核心概念）
entries.b: 二、Core Concepts（核心概念） English explanation (paraphrase): Ratio analysis examines the relationship between two related items of financial information. 中文： ratio analysis （比率分析）：两个相互关联的财务数据之间的关系 English explanation (paraphrase): ROE measures the profitability of the owner's capital: divide net profit by average owner's equity. 中文： ROE （净资产收益率）：net profit / average owner's equity，衡量业主资本的盈利效率 English explanation (paraphrase): ROA measures the return generated from total assets: divide net profit by average total assets. 中文： ROA （总资产收益率）：net profit / average total assets English explanation (paraphrase): Net profit margin is net profit divided by net sales; it measures the proportion of sales retained as net profit. 中文： net profit margin （销售净利率）：net profit / net sales English explanation (paraphrase): The current and quick ratios assess short-term payment capacity. The quick ratio excludes sto

entries.t: 📖 三、Key Details & Interpretation（重点详解与解读方法）
entries.b: 三、Key Details & Interpretation（重点详解与解读方法） English explanation (paraphrase): A complete ratio answer has three parts: show the calculation, state the comparison, and explain the business implication. 中文：比率题的标准答法分三层：给出计算过程、给出比较结论、给出经营含义。 English explanation (paraphrase): For an average-balance ratio, calculate the denominator as (opening balance + closing balance) / 2 rather than using a single day's figure to represent the year. 中文：average balance 类指标用 (opening + closing) / 2 计算分母，避免用单日数字代表全年。 English explanation (paraphrase): Interpret in three stages: calculate the ratio; compare it with the trend or industry average; then state whether the result is favourable or unfavourable and explain why. Name the comparator so that the conclusion is supported. 中文：解读三步：算出比率 → 与 trend 或 industry average 比较 → 给出 favourable 或 unfavourable 结论与原因；结论必须带比较对象，否则没有说服力。 English explanation (paraphrase): A cu

entries.t: 📖 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点）
entries.b: 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点） English explanation (paraphrase): Do not conclude from a single-period ratio alone. Without a benchmark, it is only a number. 中文：单期比率不能下结论，必须比较；没有比较基准的比率只是一个数字。 English explanation (paraphrase): A balance sheet is a snapshot at a single date. Even the opening/closing average may not represent the full year, particularly in a seasonal business. 中文：balance sheet 是单日快照，期初期末平均未必代表全年；季节性强的企业尤其要小心。 English explanation (paraphrase): One-off and non-recurring items can distort ratios. Identify and remove their effect before evaluating the underlying operating performance. 中文：一次性、非经常项目会扭曲比率，解读前先剔除，再评价主营业务的真实表现。 English explanation (paraphrase): Profitability and liquidity can diverge: a profitable business may still lack cash. The cash flow statement helps explain this difference. 中文：profitability 与 liquidity 可能背离：盈利企业也可能现金短缺；这正是现金流量表存在的原因。

entries.t: 📌 Statement of Cash Flows（现金流量表）
entries.b: Statement of Cash Flows（现金流量表） The Statement of Cash Flows summarises actual cash inflows and cash outflows during an accounting period, classified into Operating, Investing and Financing activities, reconciling Opening Cash to Closing Cash. 现金流量表汇总企业在一个会计期间内实际的现金流入与流出，分为经营、投资、筹资三大活动，并将期初现金核对至期末现金余额。

entries.t: 📌 Operating Activities（经营活动现金流）
entries.b: Operating Activities（经营活动现金流） Operating cash flows arise from core day-to-day revenue-producing activities, such as cash receipts from customers and cash payments to suppliers, employees, rent and taxes. 经营活动现金流来自企业日常主营业务，如收客户货款、付供应商货款、发工资、交房租和缴税，是企业自我「造血」能力的核心指标。

entries.t: 📌 Investing & Financing Activities（投资与筹资活动现金流）
entries.b: Investing & Financing Activities（投资与筹资活动现金流） Investing activities cover cash paid for or received from buying and selling non-current assets (e.g. equipment, property); Financing activities cover cash flows with owners and lenders (capital contributions, drawings, bank loans and repayments). 投资活动反映买卖设备、房产等长期资产的现金收支；筹资活动反映与老板和银行之间的资金往来（注资、提款、借入与偿还贷款）。

entries.t: 📌 Why Net Profit ≠ Net Cash Flow（净利润为何不等于净现金流）
entries.q: Why Net Profit ≠ Net Cash Flow
entries.b: Why Net Profit ≠ Net Cash Flow（净利润为何不等于净现金流） Net Profit is calculated on an accrual basis (including credit sales, credit purchases and non-cash expenses like depreciation), whereas cash flow records only actual cash received and paid. 净利润按权责发生制核算（包含未收现的赊销、未付现的赊购以及折旧等非现金费用），而现金流量表只记真正进出银行账户的真金白银。

entries.t: 🎯 Classify each cash transaction into Operating, Investing or Financing: (a) Cash paid to buy delivery van; (b) Cash received from customers; (c) Owner’s cash drawings; (d) Interest paid on bank loan.
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 11 · 必考大题
entries.b: Classify each cash transaction into Operating, Investing or Financing: (a) Cash paid to buy delivery van; (b) Cash received from customers; (c) Owner’s cash drawings; (d) Interest paid on bank loan. 请将下列现金收支归类到经营/投资/筹资活动：(a) 付现买货车；(b) 收客户货款；(c) 老板现金提款；(d) 支付银行贷款利息。 Investing Operating Financing (a) Buying a delivery van → Investing outflow (acquisition of a Non-Current Asset). (a) 买货车 → 投资活动现金流出（购置非流动资产）。 (b) Cash from customers → Operating inflow; (d) Interest paid → Operating outflow (day-to-day cost of operations). (b) 收客户货款 → 经营活动现金流入；(d) 付利息 → 经营活动现金流出（日常经营费用）。 (c) Owner’s drawings → Financing outflow (distribution of equity back to the owner). (c) 老板提款 → 筹资活动现金流出（向所有者返还权益资金）。

entries.t: 🎯 Why is Depreciation NOT listed as a cash outflow in the direct-method Statement of Cash Flows?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 11 · 必考大题
entries.b: Why is Depreciation NOT listed as a cash outflow in the direct-method Statement of Cash Flows? 为什么折旧费用（Depreciation）不会作为现金流出列在直接法现金流量表中？ non-cash expense cash outflow occurred at purchase Depreciation is a non-cash bookkeeping allocation of an asset’s historical cost over its useful life; the actual cash outflow already occurred when the asset was purchased (Investing activity). 折旧只是将资产原值分摊为费用的非现金会计记账动作，真正花出去的现金早在买资产那天就记在投资活动里了，绝不能重复扣现金。

It answers where cash came from, where it went and how much it changed. Unlike the other statements, it uses the cash basis. 中文：Unit 10 第二部分讲解 cash flow statement：按 operating、investing、financing 三类活动追踪现金流入流出，并调节资产负债表中期初期末现金余额。它回答三个问题：现金从哪来、到哪去、增减多少，是三大报表中唯一按收付制编制的。

entries.b: 二、Core Concepts（核心概念） English explanation (paraphrase): The cash flow statement reports changes in cash on the cash basis during a period and reconciles opening and closing cash at bank. 中文： cash flow statement （现金流量表）：按 cash basis 反映期间现金变动，调节期初期末 cash at bank English explanation (paraphrase): Operating activities include receipts from customers, payments to suppliers and employees, and payments of interest and tax. 中文： operating activities （经营活动）：收顾客款、付供应商与员工款、付利息与税 English explanation (paraphrase): Investing activities include buying and selling non-current assets and longer-term investments. 中文： investing activities （投资活动）：购置或处置非流动资产、对外投资与贷款 English explanation (paraphrase): Financing activities include borrowing and repayment, issuing new shares and paying dividends. 中文： financing activities （筹资活动）：借款还款、发新股、付股利 English explanation (paraphrase): The direct and indirect methods present

First determine whether actual cash was received or paid, then classify the activity. 中文：分类题是常见题型，做法是逐笔判断有无现金收付，再决定归属类别。 English explanation (paraphrase): The statements connect: net profit from the income statement enters capital on the balance sheet, while the cash flow statement explains the change in balance-sheet cash. 中文：三张表关系：income statement 的 net profit 流入 capital；balance sheet 的现金变动由 cash flow statement 解释。 English explanation (paraphrase): Classify core business transactions as operating, long-term asset purchases or disposals as investing, and borrowing or equity changes as financing. If uncertain, identify what the transaction changes in substance. 中文：分类判断口诀：主营买卖相关属 operating，买卖长期资产属 investing，借钱与权益相关属 financing；拿不准时先问这笔交易改变了什么。 English explanation (paraphras

entries.t: 📖 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点）
entries.b: 四、Common Mistakes & Confusions（常见错误与易混点） English explanation (paraphrase): Cash can rise even when a business reports a loss, because profit contains non-cash items and receipt/payment timing differs from recognition timing. 中文：亏损企业现金也可能增加，因为利润含非现金项目且收付时间不同。 English explanation (paraphrase): An asset acquired by issuing a bill payable does not belong in the cash flow statement if no cash changes hands. No-cash transactions are excluded from its cash receipts and payments. 中文：以长期票据赊购机器、没有现金收付的交易不列入现金流量表。 English explanation (paraphrase): Collection from debtors is operating, not investing. Investing concerns long-term assets and longer-term investments. 中文：收回应收账款属 operating，不是 investing；投资活动只涉及长期资产与对外投资。 English explanation (paraphrase): The cash flow statement does not analyse profitability and cannot directly forecast future cash flows. 中文：现金流量表不能分析 profitability，也无法直接预测未来现金流。

entries.t: 📊 现金流量表的作用与三类活动
entries.q: 现金流量表的作用与三类活动
entries.b: 现金流量表的作用与三类活动 unit10 lecture slides cash flow statement.pdf · PDF p2–13；unit10 reading materials cash flow statement.pdf · PDF p1–6；unit10 tutorial guide cash flow.pdf · PDF p2–5 概念 三张报表的关系：利润表的净利润进入所有者权益（资产负债表）；现金流量表解释资产负债表上现金从期初到期末为什么变化。 利润表用 权责发生制 （交易发生时确认），现金流量表用 现金制 （收付现金时确认）。 经营活动 ：主要的创收活动——收客户款、付供应商和员工、付利息、交所得税。 投资活动 ：购买或出售长期资产和投资、借出或收回贷款、收到股利。 筹资活动 ：借款和还款、发行或回购股份、支付股利。 不涉及现金的交易（以资产换资产、用长期票据买机器、折旧）不进现金流量表。 作用：评估产生现金的能力、偿债能力（流动性、偿付能力）、利润和经营现金流差异的原因、投资和筹资情况。局限：不反映盈利能力；收付时点可被安排；是历史数据。 经营现金流 的两种列法：直接法（列出实际收付）和间接法（从净利润调整非现金项目和营运资本变化）。 现金流分类（讲义 p12） Cash inflows Cash outflows Operating （与收入、费用有关） 销售商品或服务收到的现金 付给供应商、员工、其他费用；付利息；交所得税、GST Inves

entries.b: 编制和解读现金流量表 unit10 lecture slides cash flow statement.pdf · PDF p7；unit10 tutorial guide cash flow.pdf · PDF p5–8；unit10 lecture exercise cf statement.xlsx · PDF Sheet1 概念 编制步骤：①把每笔现金收付归入经营、投资、筹资；②各类加总，流出用括号；③三类合计 = 现金净增减；④期初现金 + 净增减 = 期末现金，核对资产负债表。 解读：经营现金流为正且稳定，说明主营业务能自己产生现金；投资活动大额流出通常表示在扩张，流入（卖资产）可能表示在收缩；筹资流入表示在借钱或增资，流出表示在还债或分红。 例 9（Tutorial Q6） King Fisheries Pty Ltd, cash account summary 2018: Balance 1 Jan 8,000; Receipts from customers 264,000; Dividends received 6,000; Proceeds from sale of equipment 36,000; Proceeds from issue of shares 200,000; Payments for goods; Payments for operating expenses 140,000; Interest paid 30,000; Taxes p

entries.t: 📌 Method Marks & Own-Figure Rule（过程分与延续计算原则）
entries.b: Method Marks & Own-Figure Rule（过程分与延续计算原则） Showing clear workings, formulas and properly formatted headings earns method marks even if an earlier arithmetic error carries forward into a final statement. 清晰写出公式、计算过程和标准报表标题即使前面某处算错，后续步骤只要方法正确依然能拿到大部分过程分（Own-Figure Rule）。

entries.t: 📌 High-Frequency Cross-Unit Traps（跨单元四大高频扣分坑）
entries.b: High-Frequency Cross-Unit Traps（跨单元四大高频扣分坑） Always verify four traps: (1) Drawings never enter the Income Statement; (2) Adjusting entries never touch Cash; (3) Freight-In goes into COGS while Freight-Out is a Selling Expense; (4) Accumulated Depreciation is deducted from Non-Current Assets. 考前最后核对四大雷区：①提款绝不进利润表；②调整分录绝不碰现金；③进货运费进 COGS、送货运费进销售费用；④累计折旧在资产负债表原值下方扣减。

entries.t: 🎯 How should you structure a 5-mark "Explain and apply an accounting convention" answer in the final exam?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 12 · 必考大题
entries.b: How should you structure a 5-mark "Explain and apply an accounting convention" answer in the final exam? 期末遇到 5 分的「解释并结合案例应用某项会计惯例」大题，高分答题结构应该怎么写？ Define Apply to case facts Quantify statement impact 1) Name and define the convention accurately in one crisp sentence (1–2 marks). 第 1 步：准确点名并用一句完整规范英文写出该惯例定义（拿 1–2 分）。 2) Apply it explicitly to the scenario’s numbers/characters — explain what was done right or wrong (2 marks). 第 2 步：紧扣题干具体人名与数字指出错在哪或该怎么处理（拿 2 分）。 3) State the exact impact on Profit, Assets, Liabilities or Equity if the error is not corrected (1–2 marks). 第 3 步：点出若不纠正会对利润、资产、负债或权益造成虚增还是虚减（拿满压轴分）。

entries.t: 🎯 Before handing in a Balance Sheet in the exam, what five quick checks guarantee maximum presentation marks?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 12 · 必考大题
entries.b: Before handing in a Balance Sheet in the exam, what five quick checks guarantee maximum presentation marks? 考试画完资产负债表准备交卷前，哪五项快速检查能稳拿全部格式与配平分？ As at date CA/NCA & CL/NCL Net Assets = Equity Check: (1) Full 3-line title with "As at [Date]"; (2) Current vs Non-Current subtotals clearly separated; (3) Accumulated Depreciation shown as a deduction; (4) Opening Capital + Net Profit − Drawings reconciled; (5) Net Assets = Total Owner’s Equity. 逐项勾选：①三行完整标题含 "As at..."；②流动/非流动分组小计清晰；③累计折旧正确扣减；④权益表勾稽正确；⑤净资产严格等于期末所有者权益。

entries.t: 🎯 Why does Closing Inventory from the additional information appear TWICE in the financial statements (both Income Statement and Balance Sheet)?
entries.s: 会计学 · Term 1 · Week 13 · 必考大题
entries.b: Why does Closing Inventory from the additional information appear TWICE in the financial statements (both Income Statement and Balance Sheet)? 为什么题目附加信息里给出的「期末存货（Closing Inventory）」在财务报表里要出现两次？ deducted from COGS Current Asset on Balance Sheet Matching principle First, it is deducted inside Cost of Goods Sold on the Income Statement because unsold stock is NOT an expense of the current period (Matching principle). 第一次：在利润表 COGS 中减去期末存货，因为还没卖出去的货不是本期的销货成本（遵循配比原则）。 Second, it is listed as a Current Asset on the Balance Sheet because the unsold goods remain owned by the business and will generate future economic benefits when sold next period. 第二次：在资产负债表列为流动资产，因为这批未售商品仍归企业所有，下期卖出即可带来经济利益流入。
